camera.description: For set_camera: {'position': [x, y, z], 'target': [x, y, z], 'up': [x, y, z], 'fov': 50, 'projection': 'perspective', 'transition': true}, every field optional. Coordinates are metres in the model's own axes (z up), the same frame measurements use. action='context' returns the current camera in this shape, so read it, change one field, send it back.

clear.description: For section: turn every existing cut off first.

guids.description: GlobalIds for select, isolate, hide, focus, fit and measure_elements, and the element to shoot from for measure_clearance. All but select default to the user's viewer selection. Use selector instead of pasting a long list.

model_id.description: Resident IFC model to control. Pass model_id returned by get_viewer_selection. When omitted, selection-based actions follow the model the user selected in; other actions use the active console model.

name.description: Viewpoint name for save_view and restore_view.

padding.description: For fit: multiplier on the framed radius. 1.0 is snug, 1.5 leaves the element in its context.

points.description: For measure_points, in model axes (z up). Two points measure a distance, three the angle at the middle one, four or more the area of the outline they close.

projection.description: For set_projection. Orthographic is parallel projection: use it whenever a length read off the screen has to mean the same thing anywhere in the frame.

section.description: For section: {'z': {'at': 1.2, 'keep': 'below'}} cuts the model's z axis at 1.2 m and keeps what is below it. Axes are the model's own (z up), positions are metres, and {'z': false} turns that axis off.

selection.description: For fit: frame the user's current viewer selection. Without it, and without guids or selector, fit frames the whole model.

selector.description: query_elements selector standing in for guids on select, isolate, hide, focus and fit, resolved against the requested model here: selector='IfcDoor, location=Level 2' isolates a storey's doors in one call and is not capped at 500 ids.

slice_depth.description: For section: keep this many metres beyond each cut instead of everything, which is what turns a cut into a floor plan. 0 keeps everything.

view.description: Camera direction for set_view, and optionally for fit.

id.description: A model_id or an attachment alias.

set_b.description: Selector for the second set; omit to clash set_a with itself.
